title: GTA VI: Story Explained
label: OFFICIAL STORY SETUP
script: What is Grand Theft Auto Six actually about? Jason and Lucia are chasing a better life in Leonida. But when an easy score goes wrong, they're pulled into a criminal conspiracy stretching across the state. They must rely on each other to survive. This is the official premise, not a story spoiler.

scenes.caption: Chasing a better life in Leonida
A criminal conspiracy across the state
